blocks.text: Goes here. Structuring the e-commerce business, organizational design, hiring, process automation, project management, 3PL negotiations, supply chain visibility, forecasting, and calculating the true unit economics of a product (including duties and landed COGS).
Paid advertising strategy, budgeting, or customer acquisition -> 11-ADC
E-commerce finance, bookkeeping, cash flow, and tax structure -> 20-FIN

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the organizational and operational structure of an 8-figure e-commerce brand, outlining strict product development (Tech Packs), forecasting variables (lead times, safety stock), and 3PL Service Level Agreements (SLAs). modules: [OPS] topics: [supply chain, tech packs, 3pl management, unit economics, organizational design, customer service] tier: 1 scope_hint: core

Topics. supply chain / Establishing a "Critical Path" for product development and launch, detailing every sequence from fabric strike-offs and first samples to Quality Control (QC) inspections and Purchase Orders (POs). The necessity of hiring a QC agent (e.g., via Alibaba or SGS) for the first few production runs. Managing Freight Logistics by comparing rates from 2-3 freight forwarders simultaneously, and logging the Estimated Departure Date, Estimated Arrival Date (ETA), Vessel Number, and Bill of Lading in an internal master spreadsheet that is restricted from supplier manipulation. tech packs / The absolute necessity of creating a Technical Pack (Tech Pack) to prevent supplier discrepancies and protect IP. Components include: 1) Complete drawings (to clarify details like print placement), 2) Fabric specifications (including GSM for thickness/density and treatment rules like acid washing), 3) Measurements (crucial for sizing and grading), 4) Graphics, 5) Hardware (zips, pockets), and 6) Labels and packaging. Utilizing Tech Packs to prove supplier undercutting (e.g., weighing fabrics) and facilitate easy manufacturer transitions. 3pl management / Managing Third-Party Logistics (3PLs). Conducting a Request for Pricing (RFP) by providing product dimensions, forecasts, and historical data to multiple 3PLs to enforce competition. Identifying red flags (e.g., using stolen shopping carts to move goods). Mandating barcode usage for accurate inventory tracking. Breaking down 3PL pricing into Pick/Pack, Inbounds (unloading containers), Outbounds (courier rates, which vary drastically based on the 3PL's total volume), and Storage. The necessity of a Service Level Agreement (SLA) outlining exact "Picked on Time" metrics with financial penalties for failures, especially during Q4 peaks. Auditing 3PL bills monthly using a custom spreadsheet based on Shopify order volume. unit economics / Calculating the true cost of a product before marketing. Formula: Sale Price - Cost of Product - Freight (per unit) - Courier Cost (pick/pack + shipping) - Storage - Duties (sunk costs based on region, distinct from sales tax) - Payment Fees. Inputting this landed cost into Shopify's "Cost per item" field to enable accurate, automated daily profit reporting via tools like Triple Whale. organizational design / Structuring the executive team. The CEO oversees the CFO (Finance), CMO (Marketing), and COO (Operations). The COO manages Product, Supply Chain (forecasting/planning), Fulfillment, and Customer Service. Recognizing that operations act as "weeding the garden"—if neglected, the revenue seeds planted by marketing will be choked out by stockouts or fulfillment disasters. customer service / Operating a blended local/international customer service team (using international agents for basic tickets and local agents for nuanced, complex escalations). Tracking operational efficiency through customer service metrics: Resolution Time, Touchpoints, and Cost Per Service (total CS expenses divided by ticket volume). Using the "Cost Per Service" metric to forecast hiring needs during peak seasonal sales.

Look for. The definition of a Tech Pack: a comprehensive document detailing drawings, fabric GSM, measurements, hardware, and labels, used to hold manufacturers accountable. The specific components of unit economics: Sale Price, Cost of Goods (COGS), Freight, Courier, Storage, Duties, and Payment Fees. The definition of a 3PL RFP: Request for Pricing, where a brand submits forecasts and dimensions to multiple warehouses to force competitive bids. The distinction between sales tax and duties: duties are a sunk cost based on import regions and must be factored into unit economics, whereas sales tax is collected and remitted. The specific components of a 3PL SLA: Picked on time guarantees, delivered on time tracking, and mandated bi-annual cycle counts.

Skip. General complaints about the BBC calling the creator a scammer. Plugs for Daily Mentor or the Oodie brand unless specifically explaining an operational concept (like weighted blanket discrepancies).
Scope mix. Baseline (Tech Packs, unit economics formulas) mixed with Growth (3PL negotiations, global CS team structures).
